title: 4 February 1963: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ final lunchtime show at Liverpool’s Cavern Club. Although they played subsequent shows at the venue, they were all evening performances.

This was The Beatles’ 277th known Cavern Club performance, and their 155th evening show.

The precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, although The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the underground venue took place on 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

  • 1972: Press conference: John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1972: Television: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on The Mike Douglas Show
  • 1971: Recording: I Lie Around by Wings; Long Haired Lady by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: John Lennon and Yoko Ono donate a bag of their hair to Michael X
  • 1968: Recording: Across The Universe
  • 1965: Paul McCartney and Jane Asher holiday in Tunisia
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Lathom Hall, Liverpool
